title: Gift App Ending Deck
project: giving my gift to the world (public gift swipe app, Machan's second post on X)
example_data: All app screens are rendered HTML mockups with made-up SAMPLE data (recipient "Robin", .example stores).

optionA.label: Top ten to choose from
optionA.desc: Ranked list of the ten best. Tap one to make it the gift.
optionA.more: Gives full control and a calm overview. Less of a moment.

optionB.label: Final face-off
optionB.desc: A mini bracket of head-to-heads until one gift wins.
optionB.more: Keeps the swiping going right to the end. About seven quick picks.

optionA.label: Big single reveal
optionA.desc: One gift, lit up, full screen. "This is the one."
optionA.more: The most giftable moment, great for sharing. No second choices on screen.

optionB.label: Top-three podium
optionB.desc: Gold, silver, bronze. Pick from the podium.
optionB.more: A playful reveal that still leaves a choice. Clear winner in the middle.

pairs.ask: Head to head: face-off or podium?

optionB.label: Top-three podium
optionB.desc: The app ranks the final three for you.
optionB.more: Less work, a bit of a show.

pairs.ask: Head to head: shortlist or top ten?

optionA.label: Shortlist with buy links, sent to you
optionA.desc: Your three best with store links, emailed so you can buy later.
optionA.more: Practical: the hunt ends with something in your inbox. Asks for an email.

optionB.label: Top ten to choose from
optionB.desc: Ten ranked gifts on screen, choose one now.
optionB.more: No email needed. Everything stays on the page.

pairs.ask: How does the winning gift appear?

optionA.label: Card flip with Machan's wink
optionA.desc: The card turns over, Machan winks from the corner.
optionA.more: The wink lands the moment. Under a second, no sound.

optionB.label: Soft glow, no mascot
optionB.desc: A warm glow and one slow sheen across the card. Quiet and elegant.
optionB.more: Subtle shine, never glitter. Machan stays in the footer only.

optionA.label: "This is the one."
optionA.desc: Short, confident, the same for everyone.

optionB.label: "Robin is going to love this."
optionB.desc: Uses their name and the occasion. Personal.
optionB.more: Feels like a friend talking. Needs a name in setup (optional).

pairs.ask: How can people share the result?

optionA.label: Share card
optionA.desc: A pretty card image to post or message. Secret by default: no gift shown unless you choose.
optionA.more: Spreads the app without spoiling the surprise. "I found Robin's gift in five minutes."

optionB.label: Private link only
optionB.desc: A link to your result for you or a co-gifter. No public card.
optionB.more: Simple and private. Good for splitting a gift with someone.

pairs.ask: How do people keep their result?

optionA.label: Email it to me
optionA.desc: One field, one tap. The list and links land in your inbox.
optionA.more: Easy to find later. The only time we ask for an email, and it is optional.

optionB.label: Save to this phone
optionB.desc: Save to notes or add to the home screen. No email.
optionB.more: Zero sign-up. A small "saved here" banner reminds people where it is.

pairs.ask: How do the buy links work?

optionA.label: One Buy button each
optionA.desc: Each gift has one clear Buy button to one store.
optionA.more: The fastest path from idea to order.

optionB.label: Compare stores fold-down
optionB.desc: Tap a gift to unfold a few stores and prices.
optionB.more: Helps find the best price or the fastest delivery. One more tap.

pairs.ask: What is the last thing on screen?

optionA.label: "Find another gift"
optionA.desc: One big button to start a new hunt for someone else.
optionA.more: Simple loop. Most people have more than one person to shop for.

optionB.label: Remind me before the day
optionB.desc: Pick the date, get a nudge a week before to order.
optionB.more: Turns a fun moment into a gift that actually arrives on time. Needs an email or calendar add.
